title: Mana and lands
summary: Lands make mana. One land per turn. Five colours. Reading costs.

checklist.label: I know how to tap a land for mana
I know I can play one land per turn
I know the five colours and their basic lands
I can read a mana cost

steps.title: Lands make mana
steps.body:
[[mana|Mana]] is the energy you spend to cast spells. Most of it comes from [[land|lands]].

To use a land, you [[tap]] it: turn it sideways. It makes one mana. It stays tapped until your next turn begins, when it [[untap|untaps]].

Playing a land is free. A land isn't a spell, so it never costs mana.

visual.src: A land card upright, then the same land turned sideways with one mana symbol floating above it.
visual.altText: A land being tapped, turned sideways, to make one mana.

steps.title: One land per turn
steps.body:
You may play **one land per turn**, and only during your own [[main-phase|main phase]].

That's why mana grows slowly. If you play a land every turn, you'll have one mana on turn 1, two on turn 2, three on turn 3, and so on.

So playing a land each turn really matters, especially early on.

visual.src: Three turns side by side: one land on turn 1, two lands on turn 2, three lands on turn 3.
visual.altText: Lands adding up, one per turn, over three turns.

check.question: You already played a land this turn. Can you play another one?

options.text: Yes, if I have enough mana
No, it's one land per turn
Yes, in my second main phase

check.hint: The rule counts lands per turn, not per main phase. And lands don't cost mana.

steps.title: The five colours

visual.src: The five basic lands in a row, each with its mana symbol and colour name underneath.
visual.altText: Plains, Island, Swamp, Mountain and Forest, each with its mana symbol.

check.question: Which basic land makes blue mana?
check.hint: Think of water: what's surrounded by blue sea?

steps.title: Reading a mana cost
steps.body:
A [[mana-cost|mana cost]] mixes two kinds of symbols:

- **Coloured symbols**, like {R}, must be paid with that exact colour.
- **Numbers**, like {2}, are [[generic-mana|generic mana]]: pay them with any colour.

So {2}{G}{G} means two green mana, plus two more of any colour: 4 mana in total.

visual.src: The cost 2, green, green, with arrows: the two green symbols need Forests, the 2 can be any lands.
visual.altText: A cost of two generic and two green mana, explained.

check.question: A card costs 2 generic mana plus 2 green mana. How much mana is that in total?
check.hint: Add the number to the count of coloured symbols.

steps.title: Use it or lose it
steps.body:
When you tap a land, its mana goes into your [[mana-pool|mana pool]] until you spend it.

Unused mana **disappears at the end of each step and phase**. You can't save it for later.

Tip: tap only the lands you need, right when you cast a spell.

visual.src: Three tapped lands, two mana spent on a spell, and the third mana fading away.
visual.altText: Leftover mana fading away at the end of the step.

check.question: You tapped three lands but only spent two mana. What happens to the third?

options.text: It's saved for my next turn
It disappears at the end of the step or phase
It turns back into a land

check.hint: Look at the bold sentence in the middle of this step.
